_note: Chapter 12 词汇卡内容。ipa = 音标; ex = 例句数组, 顺序与词表中该词出现的行序一致(多词性词给多个例句, 每个例句对应词性行); note = 用法提示/搭配。

ex.en: No one goes into the water alone; that is an absolute rule.
ex.cn: 谁也不许独自下水，这是绝对的规矩。
ex.note: an absolute rule 铁律；absolute certainty 绝对确定

ex.en: He was soon accustomed to the heat and the long days.
ex.cn: 他很快就习惯了这里的暑热和漫长的白天。
ex.note: be accustomed to 习惯于

ex.en: Admission to the museum is free for students.
ex.cn: 学生可以免费参观这家博物馆。
ex.note: admission to 准许进入；free admission 免费入场

ex.en: His aggressive tone made everyone in the room nervous.
ex.cn: 他咄咄逼人的语气让屋里所有人都紧张起来。
ex.note: aggressive behaviour 咄咄逼人的行为；aggressive sales 强势推销

ex.en: The council began to look for an alternative site for the hotel.
ex.cn: 议会开始为酒店另找选址。
ex.note: an alternative to … …的替代方案

ex.en: If the plan fails, we will try an alternative route.
ex.cn: 如果这个方案行不通，我们就换一条路线。

ex.en: The club marked its tenth anniversary with a simple dinner.
ex.cn: 俱乐部用一顿简单的晚餐庆祝成立十周年。
ex.note: the nth anniversary 第 n 个周年纪念日

ex.en: The speaker received a long round of applause.
ex.cn: 演讲者得到了长时间的掌声。
ex.note: win / draw applause 赢得掌声

ex.en: They made an arrangement to meet at the school gate.
ex.cn: 他们约定在校门口碰面。
ex.note: make an arrangement with sb. 与某人约定

ex.en: He gave me the assurance that the job was safe.
ex.cn: 他向我保证这份工作安全可靠。
ex.note: give sb. the assurance that … 向某人保证…；self-assurance 自信

ex.en: Autumn is the best season to walk along the coast.
ex.cn: 秋天是沿海岸散步的最好季节。
ex.note: in autumn 在秋天

ex.en: The school band played a slow march in the courtyard.
ex.cn: 学校乐队在院子里演奏了一支缓慢的进行曲。
ex.note: a rock band 摇滚乐队；a band of 一群

ex.en: To be honest, I had no idea what to do next.
ex.cn: 老实说，我完全不知道下一步该做什么。
ex.note: be able to 能够；be used to 习惯于

ex.en: This copy belongs to the school library, so it must be returned.
ex.cn: 这一本属于学校图书馆，得按时还回去。
ex.note: belong to 属于

ex.en: We waited a bit and then started again.
ex.cn: 我们等了一小会儿，然后重新开始。
ex.note: a bit 一点；a bit of 一点点

ex.en: Music creates a bond between people who have never met.
ex.cn: 音乐在素不相识的人之间建立起纽带。
ex.note: a bond with 与…之间的纽带

ex.en: Do not break the glass; it was a gift.
ex.cn: 别打碎这只玻璃杯，它是件礼物。
ex.note: break into 闯入；a break in the rain 一阵雨间歇

ex.en: Let us take a short break before we go on.
ex.cn: 我们继续之前先休息一会儿。

ex.en: She carried a bunch of wildflowers back to the dormitory.
ex.cn: 她把一大束野花带回宿舍。
ex.note: a bunch of 一束/一群

ex.en: The sea was calm, and not a single boat moved.
ex.cn: 海面很平静，一条船也没动。
ex.note: calm down 平静下来；stay calm 保持冷静

ex.en: She tried to calm the frightened children with a song.
ex.cn: 她用一首歌安抚受惊的孩子。

ex.en: Tourists rode through the village in an old horse carriage.
ex.cn: 游客们乘坐一辆旧马车穿过村子。
ex.note: a railway carriage 火车车厢

ex.en: He did not pay a cent for the ticket, and he did not want thanks.
ex.cn: 他没为那张票花一分钱，也不打算接受感谢。
ex.note: not a cent 一分钱也不；per cent 百分之

ex.en: He cheated in the exam and was expelled.
ex.cn: 他考试作弊，被开除了。
ex.note: cheat at / in 考试作弊；a great cheat 大骗子

ex.en: No one believed the cheat, and the room grew cold.
ex.cn: 没人相信那个骗子，屋子里的气氛一下子冷了下来。

ex.en: The old church stands at the centre of the village.
ex.cn: 那座老教堂立在村子中央。
ex.note: go to church 做礼拜；the Church 教会

ex.en: Our client asked for a copy of the full report.
ex.cn: 我们的委托人索要一份完整的报告。
ex.note: serve clients 服务客户

ex.en: The museum has a large collection of old sea charts.
ex.cn: 博物馆藏有一大批古旧的航海图。
ex.note: a collection of 一批/一套

ex.en: The old dog was her only companion in the long winter.
ex.cn: 那个漫长的冬天里，老狗是她唯一的伙伴。
ex.note: a companion for … …的同伴

ex.en: He could not conceal his disappointment when the plan failed.
ex.cn: 计划失败时，他掩饰不住失望。
ex.note: conceal sth. from sb. 向某人隐瞒某事

ex.en: It took her years to conquer her fear of deep water.
ex.cn: 她花了几年时间才克服对深水的恐惧。
ex.note: conquer a mountain 征服大山

ex.en: He won first prize in the photo contest.
ex.cn: 他在摄影比赛中获得一等奖。
ex.note: a contest between … …之间的比赛

ex.en: Few people dared to contest the decision of the council.
ex.cn: 很少有人敢质疑议会的决定。

ex.en: The parcel was tied with a thin cord.
ex.cn: 包裹用一根细绳捆着。
ex.note: an electric cord 电线；a vocal cord 声带

ex.en: The children played football in the courtyard after class.
ex.cn: 下课后孩子们在院子里踢球。
ex.note: in the courtyard 在院子里

ex.en: A large crowd waited outside the hall for the results.
ex.cn: 一大群人在礼堂外等着结果。
ex.note: a crowd of 一群；crowd around 围在…周围

ex.en: They crowded into the small bus without complaining.
ex.cn: 他们一声不响地挤上了那辆小巴车。

ex.en: The cycle of the tides governs life in the fishing village.
ex.cn: 潮汐的循环支配着这个渔村的生活。
ex.note: the water cycle 水循环；cycle to work 骑车上班

ex.en: She cycles to work every morning when the weather is fine.
ex.cn: 天气好的时候，她每天早上骑车上班。

ex.en: I never want to put you in debt.
ex.cn: 我绝不想让你欠我人情。
ex.note: pay back a debt 还债；be in debt to 欠…人情

ex.en: Each group sent a delegate to speak for the others.
ex.cn: 每个小组派了一名代表替其他人发言。
ex.note: delegate tasks to sb. 把任务委派给某人

ex.en: A good leader knows how to delegate work to others.
ex.cn: 好的领导者懂得把工作分派给别人。

ex.en: She designed the poster that appeared on the village wall.
ex.cn: 她设计了那张贴在村口的海报。
ex.note: design sth. for sb. 为某人设计某物

ex.en: The design of the building is simple but elegant.
ex.cn: 这座建筑的设计简洁而雅致。

ex.en: He dictated a long letter to his assistant.
ex.cn: 他口述了一封长信给助理。
ex.note: dictate a letter 口述信件；dictate terms 发号施令

ex.en: The result disappointed everyone who had worked on it.
ex.cn: 结果让所有为此付出过的人都失望了。
ex.note: be disappointed with / in 对…失望；disappoint sb. 让某人失望

ex.en: The radio in the next room distracted him from his homework.
ex.cn: 隔壁屋里的收音机分散了他的注意力，让他做不成作业。
ex.note: distract sb. from sth. 使某人分心

ex.en: She drew a small dot on the map to mark the spot.
ex.cn: 她在地图上画了一个小点，标出那个位置。
ex.note: be dotted with 散布着…；a dot on the map 地图上的一个点

ex.en: The hills were dotted with small white houses.
ex.cn: 山间点缀着一座座白色的小房子。

ex.en: The lab found traces of a drug used in the hotel kitchen.
ex.cn: 实验室查出了酒店厨房所用那种药物的痕迹。
ex.note: drug abuse 药物滥用；a prescription drug 处方药

ex.en: She drugged the patient before the operation to keep him calm.
ex.cn: 手术前她给病人用了药，让他保持安静。

ex.en: The task looked easy on paper but was not in practice.
ex.cn: 这项任务在纸面上看着容易，实际做起来却不是。
ex.note: easy to do 容易做；be easy for sb. to do 对某人来说容易

ex.en: An elderly woman was waiting at the bus stop with a bag of vegetables.
ex.cn: 一位老妇人拎着一袋蔬菜在公交站等着。
ex.note: the elderly 老年人

ex.en: The new hotel would employ a hundred people from the village.
ex.cn: 新酒店将雇用一百名村里的人。
ex.note: employ sb. to do 雇用某人做…

ex.en: The idea was met with real enthusiasm.
ex.cn: 这个主意得到了真诚的热情回应。
ex.note: with enthusiasm 热情地；show enthusiasm for 对…表现出热情

ex.en: We walked along the shore in the cool of the evening.
ex.cn: 我们在傍晚的凉快里沿着海岸散步。
ex.note: in the evening 在晚上；Good evening 晚上好

ex.en: There was a flicker of excitement in her voice.
ex.cn: 她的声音里有一丝兴奋。
ex.note: with excitement 兴奋地

ex.en: Everyone was free to express an opinion at the meeting.
ex.cn: 会上每个人都可以畅所欲言。
ex.note: express oneself 表达自己；an express train 快车

ex.en: We took the morning express and reached the coast by noon.
ex.cn: 我们搭乘早班快车，中午就到了海边。

ex.en: The teacher gave us her express permission to leave early.
ex.cn: 老师明确允许我们提前离开。

ex.en: The report was false, and the whole story fell apart.
ex.cn: 报告是假的，整个故事一下子垮了。
ex.note: false information 虚假信息；true or false 对与错

ex.en: This is my favorite book of the year.
ex.cn: 这是我今年最喜欢的一本书。
ex.note: one's favorite … 最喜欢的…；a favorite of 受…喜爱的人

ex.en: She has always been the teacher's favorite.
ex.cn: 她一向是老师最宠爱的学生。

ex.en: He was in no mood to fight; he wanted evidence instead.
ex.cn: 他没有心思去斗殴，他想要的是证据。
ex.note: fight for 为…而战；fight against 反对；a fight 一场打斗

ex.en: A fleet of fishing boats sailed out before dawn.
ex.cn: 一支渔船队在天亮前驶出海港。
ex.note: a fleet of 一队

ex.en: The rules forbid swimming near the pipe.
ex.cn: 规定禁止在那根管子附近游泳。
ex.note: forbid sb. to do 禁止某人做；forbid doing 禁止做

ex.en: Only a small fraction of the students passed the exam.
ex.cn: 只有很小一部分学生通过了考试。
ex.note: a fraction of … …的一部分；a tiny fraction 极小的一部分

ex.en: The main function of the machine is to measure salt in water.
ex.cn: 这台机器的主要功能是测量水中的盐度。
ex.note: function as … 起…的作用；serve a function 发挥作用

ex.en: The old radio still functions perfectly.
ex.cn: 那台旧收音机仍然运转良好。

ex.en: Scientists are trying to find the genes that control this disease.
ex.cn: 科学家们正在寻找控制这种疾病的基因。
ex.note: a gene for … …的基因

ex.en: The lamps glowed softly along the path.
ex.cn: 小灯沿着小路发出柔和的光。
ex.note: glow with pride 因骄傲而容光焕发；a warm glow 暖意

ex.en: The glow of the sunset warmed the whole harbour.
ex.cn: 落日的余晖让整个港口都暖了起来。

ex.en: My grandfather told me the story of the old town.
ex.cn: 我的祖父给我讲过老城的故事。
ex.note: maternal / paternal grandfather 母系/父系祖父

ex.en: My guess is that the meeting will last an hour.
ex.cn: 我猜这个会要开一个小时。
ex.note: guess at 猜测；a wild guess 瞎猜

ex.en: She was happy with the result of the test.
ex.cn: 她对这次考试的结果很满意。
ex.note: be happy about 对…感到高兴；be happy to do 乐意做

ex.en: The village council held a public hearing on the hotel plan.
ex.cn: 村议会就酒店计划举行了公开听证会。
ex.note: a public hearing 公开听证会；hearing aid 助听器

ex.en: They went on a long hike along the coast path.
ex.cn: 他们沿着海岸小路进行了一次长途徒步。
ex.note: take / go on a hike 去远足；hike prices 大幅涨价

ex.en: The sun rose slowly above the horizon.
ex.cn: 太阳在地平线那边缓缓升起。
ex.note: on the horizon 在地平线上；broaden one's horizons 开阔眼界

ex.en: My back hurts after carrying the boxes upstairs.
ex.cn: 把箱子搬上楼以后，我后背很疼。
ex.note: hurt oneself 受伤；a hurt 疼痛/委屈

ex.en: He felt a sharp hurt in his ankle and sat down at once.
ex.cn: 他脚踝一阵锐痛，立刻坐了下来。

ex.en: The task requires an immense amount of patience.
ex.cn: 这项任务需要极大的耐心。
ex.note: an immense amount of 大量的

ex.en: The small country won its independence after a long struggle.
ex.cn: 这个小国经过长期斗争赢得了独立。
ex.note: gain / win independence 赢得独立

ex.en: He wrote his name in ink on the old wall.
ex.cn: 他用墨水在那面老墙上写下了自己的名字。
ex.note: in ink 用墨水；ink and paper 笔墨纸砚

ex.en: She is an intelligent girl who asks good questions.
ex.cn: 她是个聪明的姑娘，总能问出好问题。
ex.note: highly intelligent 极聪明的

ex.en: We received an invitation to the opening of the new library.
ex.cn: 我们收到了新图书馆开馆典礼的邀请。
ex.note: accept an invitation 接受邀请；at the invitation of 应…之邀

ex.en: Journalists from ten countries came to cover the hearing.
ex.cn: 来自十个国家的记者赶来报道这场听证会。
ex.note: a foreign journalist 外国记者

ex.en: The story describes a small kingdom by the sea.
ex.cn: 这个故事讲的是海边的一个小王国。
ex.note: the United Kingdom 联合王国；the animal kingdom 动物界

ex.en: The lab uses a laser to measure the depth of the water.
ex.cn: 实验室用激光来测量水深。
ex.note: laser surgery 激光手术

ex.en: At least half of the class has already finished the work.
ex.cn: 班上至少有一半人已经做完了这份作业。
ex.note: at least 至少；the least possible 尽可能少的

ex.en: A ray of light came through the narrow window.
ex.cn: 一束光从小窗照了进来。
ex.note: light up 点亮；traffic lights 红绿灯；light blue 浅蓝色

ex.en: They had a light lunch and went back to work.
ex.cn: 他们吃了顿简单的午餐，又回去干活。

ex.en: They light the lamps at six every evening.
ex.cn: 他们每天傍晚六点点灯。

ex.en: Rescuers located the missing boat within an hour.
ex.cn: 救援人员一小时内就找到了那条失踪的小船。
ex.note: locate the source 找到源头；be located in 位于

ex.en: We had lunch under a shady tree after the walk.
ex.cn: 散步之后，我们在一棵浓荫树下吃了午饭。
ex.note: have lunch 吃午饭；a light lunch 简单的午餐

ex.en: Manual work is slower, but the results last longer.
ex.cn: 手工活儿慢一些，但成果更经得起时间。
ex.note: a safety manual 安全手册；manual labor 体力劳动

ex.en: Read the manual carefully before you start the machine.
ex.cn: 开机之前请仔细阅读说明书。

ex.en: The hotel serves a full meal for twelve yuan.
ex.cn: 这家酒店十二块钱就能吃上一顿完整的饭。
ex.note: a full meal 一顿饱饭；go easy on a meal 节食

ex.en: The merit of the report lay in the evidence it contained.
ex.cn: 这份报告的价值在于其中所含的证据。
ex.note: on its own merits 单凭本身的长处；merit praise 值得称赞

ex.en: The plan merits closer study before it is approved.
ex.cn: 这个方案在批准之前值得更仔细地研究。

ex.en: A tall mirror stood in the corner of the room.
ex.cn: 房间角落里立着一面落地镜。
ex.note: mirror the reflection 映出倒影

ex.en: The still lake mirrored the hills and the white clouds.
ex.cn: 平静的湖面映出了山丘和白云。

ex.en: The volunteers gave moral support to the villagers.
ex.cn: 志愿者们在精神上给了村民支持。
ex.note: moral support 精神支持；moral standards 道德标准

ex.en: The moral of the story is that honesty pays.
ex.cn: 这个故事的寓意是诚实是有回报的。

ex.en: The evening ended with a musical performance by the school band.
ex.cn: 晚会在学校乐队的音乐演奏中结束。
ex.note: musical instruments 乐器；a musical comedy 音乐喜剧

ex.en: She has wanted to see that musical for years.
ex.cn: 她想看那部音乐剧已经很多年了。

ex.en: She wore a warm scarf around her neck.
ex.cn: 她在脖子上围了一条暖和的围巾。
ex.note: neck and neck 齐头并进；a stiff neck 僵硬酸痛的脖子

ex.en: She finished ninth in the photo contest.
ex.cn: 她在摄影比赛里得了第九名。
ex.note: the ninth of August 八月九日；ninth grade 九年级

ex.en: There was nowhere to sit, so the old people stood by the door.
ex.cn: 连坐的地方都没有，老人们只好站在门边。
ex.note: nowhere near 远不是；go nowhere 不管用

ex.en: There was an odd smell near the rocks, and nobody could explain it.
ex.cn: 岩石附近有一股怪味，谁也说不清是怎么来的。
ex.note: an odd number 奇数；odd hours 零散的时间

ex.en: In the debate he faced a strong opponent who never raised his voice.
ex.cn: 辩论中他遇到一个从不提高嗓门的强劲对手。
ex.note: a political opponent 政治对手；defeat an opponent 击败对手

ex.en: The club organizes outdoor activities every spring.
ex.cn: 俱乐部每年春天都组织户外活动。
ex.note: outdoor activities 户外活动；outdoor clothes 户外服装

ex.en: He wrote the numbers down in a small writing pad.
ex.cn: 他把数字记在一个小本子上。
ex.note: a writing pad 写字本；a pad of paper 一叠纸

ex.en: I like fruit, particularly apples and pears.
ex.cn: 我喜欢水果，尤其是苹果和梨。
ex.note: particularly in 尤其在；not particularly 并不特别

ex.en: The story describes the hard life of a peasant in the old days.
ex.cn: 这个故事讲述了旧日农民艰苦的生活。
ex.note: peasant farming 农耕

ex.en: She persuaded him to change his mind at last.
ex.cn: 她终于说服他改变了主意。
ex.note: persuade sb. to do 说服某人做；persuade sb. of … 使某人相信…

ex.en: The door pinched his finger as it closed.
ex.cn: 门关上的时候夹疼了他的手指。
ex.note: a pinch of 一撮/少量；pinch one's fingers 捏手指

ex.en: She put a pinch of salt on the tomatoes.
ex.cn: 她在番茄上撒了一小撮盐。

ex.en: He taught the children a short poem about the sea.
ex.cn: 他教孩子们一首关于大海的短诗。
ex.note: a poem in memory of 纪念…的诗

ex.en: Each guest received a generous portion of rice and fish.
ex.cn: 每位来客都得到了一大份米饭和鱼。
ex.note: a large / small portion of 大份/小份；a portion of the money 一部分钱

ex.en: They took every precaution against infection before the surgery.
ex.cn: 手术前他们采取了全部的防感染措施。
ex.note: take precautions 采取预防措施；a precaution against 预防…的措施

ex.en: The old tale tells of a prince who lived on the hill.
ex.cn: 这个古老的传说讲的是一位住在山上的王子。
ex.note: the Prince of Wales 威尔士亲王；prince charming 白马王子

ex.en: Signs now prohibit swimming near the pipe.
ex.cn: 如今有牌子禁止在那根管子附近游泳。
ex.note: prohibit sb. from doing 禁止某人做

ex.en: The publication was read by people far beyond the village.
ex.cn: 这份出版物被远远超出村子范围的人读到。
ex.note: academic publication 学术出版物；the publication of … …的出版

ex.en: The street was quiet at that hour of the night.
ex.cn: 夜里的那个时辰，街上很安静。
ex.note: keep quiet 保持安静；quiet down 安静下来

ex.en: She lowered her voice to quiet the baby.
ex.cn: 她压低声音，好让婴儿安静下来。

ex.en: The last ray of light touched the water and was gone.
ex.cn: 最后一缕光触到水面，就消失了。
ex.note: a ray of light 一缕光；X-ray X 射线

ex.en: A young journalist held a small recorder in his hand.
ex.cn: 一位年轻记者手里拿着一台小录音机。
ex.note: tape recorder 磁带录音机；voice recorder 录音笔

ex.en: These old notes relate to the history of the harbour.
ex.cn: 这些旧笔记与港口的历史有关。
ex.note: relate to 与…有关；relate a story 讲述故事

ex.en: We are waiting for a replacement part for the tester.
ex.cn: 我们在等检测仪的替换零件。
ex.note: a replacement for … …的替代品

ex.en: It is our responsibility to protect the water we drink.
ex.cn: 保护我们饮用的水，是我们的责任。
ex.note: take responsibility for 对…负责；a sense of responsibility 责任感

ex.en: You made the right decision in the end.
ex.cn: 最后你做了正确的决定。
ex.note: the right to do 有权做…；right now 立刻；all right 好吧

ex.en: Every villager has the right to speak at the hearing.
ex.cn: 每个村民都有权在听证会上发言。

ex.en: Turn right at the second corner, then go straight on.
ex.cn: 在第二个路口右转，然后一直往前走。

ex.en: The children sat in a row and raised their hands together.
ex.cn: 孩子们坐成一排，同时举起手。
ex.note: a row of 一排；in a row 排成一排

ex.en: We rowed across the bay before the wind rose.
ex.cn: 起风之前，我们划着小船横渡海湾。

ex.en: We were in the same class, but in different years.
ex.cn: 我们上的是同一个班，只是不同年级。
ex.note: the same as 与…相同；one and the same 完全相同

ex.en: She won a scholarship to study abroad.
ex.cn: 她获得了出国留学的奖学金。
ex.note: win / receive a scholarship 获得奖学金；a scholarship student 奖学金获得者

ex.en: He planted a seed of doubt in their minds.
ex.cn: 他在他们心里种下了一颗怀疑的种子。
ex.note: a seed of hope 一线希望；seed the fields 播种

ex.en: The farmers seeded the fields before the first rain.
ex.cn: 农民们在第一场雨前把种子播进了田里。

ex.en: The village was once a small fishing settlement.
ex.cn: 这个村子曾经是个小小的渔村聚落。
ex.note: reach a settlement 达成协议；a settlement of 若干个定居点

ex.en: He bent down to tie his shoes before the race.
ex.cn: 比赛前他弯下腰系鞋带。
ex.note: a pair of shoes 一双鞋；shoe leather 鞋用皮革

ex.en: The room went silent when he began to speak.
ex.cn: 他一开口，屋子里就静了下来。
ex.note: fall silent 陷入沉默；silent about 对…保持沉默

ex.en: Her skin was burnt red by the afternoon sun.
ex.cn: 午后的太阳把她的皮肤晒得发红。
ex.note: skin cancer 皮肤癌；the skin of the fruit 果皮

ex.en: Wash your hands with soap before you eat.
ex.cn: 吃饭前先用肥皂洗手。
ex.note: a bar of soap 一块肥皂；soap and water 肥皂水

ex.en: The lab uses sophisticated equipment that few schools can afford.
ex.cn: 实验室用的是精密设备，不是几所学校都买得起的。
ex.note: sophisticated equipment 精密设备；a sophisticated taste 高雅的品味

ex.en: The spectators clapped and cheered the runners on.
ex.cn: 观众们一边鼓掌，一边为选手们喝彩。
ex.note: a keen spectator 热衷的观众；sports spectators 体育观众

ex.en: The stadium was already full when we arrived.
ex.cn: 我们到的时候，体育场里已经坐满了人。
ex.note: a football stadium 足球场

ex.en: The first step is to gather the evidence.
ex.cn: 第一步是把证据收集起来。
ex.note: step by step 一步步；take a step 迈出一步

ex.en: He stepped into the water and felt the cold shock it.
ex.cn: 他踏进水里，冷水让他猛地一惊。

ex.en: He did not have the strength to argue that evening.
ex.cn: 那天晚上他已经没有力气去争辩了。
ex.note: the strength to do 有力量做；inner strength 内在力量

ex.en: Their campaign was successful, and the plan was dropped.
ex.cn: 他们的行动成功了，那个计划被撤销了。
ex.note: a successful attempt 成功的尝试；be successful in doing 在做…方面取得成功

ex.en: They published a supplement to the original report.
ex.cn: 他们出版了原报告的补充本。
ex.note: a supplement to … …的补充；supplement a diet 补充饮食

ex.en: She supplemented her income by teaching at night.
ex.cn: 她靠夜间教书补贴收入。

ex.en: The door swings open every time the wind blows.
ex.cn: 风一吹，门就被推开。
ex.note: swing at 挥拳打；in the swing 在鼎盛期

ex.en: There was only a single swing in the whole playground.
ex.cn: 整个操场上只有一个秋千。

ex.en: Their teacher had been teaching in the village for twenty years.
ex.cn: 他们的老师已经在这村里教了二十年书。
ex.note: a school teacher 学校老师；teacher training 教师培训

ex.en: The two countries signed an agreement over the disputed territory.
ex.cn: 两国就争议领土签署了协议。
ex.note: foreign territory 外国领土；territorial waters 领海

ex.en: Think before you sign anything.
ex.cn: 签任何东西之前先想清楚。
ex.note: I think so 我想是的；think of 想到

ex.en: Her desk was always tidy, even during exams.
ex.cn: 即便考试期间，她的书桌也总是整整齐齐。
ex.note: tidy up 收拾；tidy away 收拾干净

ex.en: Please tidy the room before the guests arrive.
ex.cn: 客人们到达之前，请把房间收拾整齐。

ex.en: The village band will play in the courtyard tonight.
ex.cn: 村乐队今晚要在院子里演奏。
ex.note: tonight 今晚；see you tonight 今晚见

ex.en: It is not easy to translate poetry without losing its music.
ex.cn: 要把诗译得又不失韵味，并不容易。
ex.note: translate A into B 把 A 译成 B；translate … from … 从…翻译

ex.en: A truck waited outside the hall, loaded with tools.
ex.cn: 一辆卡车停在礼堂外面，车上装满了工具。
ex.note: a fire truck 消防车；truck driver 卡车司机

ex.en: He lay unconscious on the sand for a few minutes.
ex.cn: 他在沙滩上昏迷了几分钟。
ex.note: be unconscious of 意识不到；lose consciousness 失去知觉

ex.en: Please update the map before the next team arrives.
ex.cn: 下一组到达之前请把地图更新一下。
ex.note: keep sb. updated 让某人及时了解情况；an update 最新消息

ex.en: Give me a quick update on the water tests.
ex.cn: 把水样检测的进展简单跟我说一下。

ex.en: The true value of the summer lay in what he had learned.
ex.cn: 这个夏天真正的价值在于他学到的东西。
ex.note: the value of … …的价值

ex.en: I value your advice more than the prize.
ex.cn: 比起奖品，我更看重你的建议。

ex.en: The storm was so violent that no boat could leave the harbour.
ex.cn: 风暴凶猛得厉害，没有一条船敢离开港口。
ex.note: a violent reaction 激烈的反应；violent crime 暴力犯罪

ex.en: The waiter brought us the bill without being asked.
ex.cn: 服务生没等我们招呼就把账单拿来了。
ex.note: a waiter in a restaurant 餐厅服务员

ex.en: You can read the full report on our website.
ex.cn: 完整报告可以在我们的网站上读到。
ex.note: on the website 在网站上；launch a website 上线网站

ex.en: Whichever route you take, take a map with you.
ex.cn: 无论走哪条路，都带上地图。
ex.note: whichever you choose 你无论选哪个；at whichever time 在任何时候

ex.en: Old age brings patience and wisdom.
ex.cn: 年岁带来的是耐心和智慧。
ex.note: the wisdom of the crowd 群体智慧；a pearl of wisdom 至理名言

ex.en: It was a worthwhile trip, though the weather was poor.
ex.cn: 尽管天气不好，这趟旅行还是值得的。
ex.note: it is worthwhile doing … 做…是值得的；be worthwhile to do 值得做

ex.en: The team worked with zero waste and no complaints.
ex.cn: 这个团队做到了零废弃，也毫无怨言。
ex.note: zero waste 零废弃；zero chance 毫无可能
